notes.title: Changes in Shelter packages
notes.notes:
Hi all

During the last days, there has been change of content in Shelter Complete Edition and Shelter: The Heart Edition, where people who bought the packages earlier got more titles automatically.
This should now be fixed and be back to the state that it was before.

We're sorry for the inconvenience we have caused.
Thank you for your understanding!

/Might & Delight

notes.title: Update - Tobii Eye Tracking
notes.notes:
There is now support for [url=https://tobiigaming.com/]Tobii Eye Tracking[/url]!

[b][u]Features[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Move the camera with extended view – the camera will turn where your eyes and head move.
[*] Sense footsteps – extend your senses, and footsteps will light up when you look at them.
[/list]

Do note that for now, eye tracking only works on Windows.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11616331/bfe5a76dd1caa94e00c981084d31177750e352f1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 24-05-2016
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Language options added! You can now choose between English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portugese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese, and Swedish. 
[*] The name in a save file sometimes going back to the default (Inna) solved.
[*] More save slots added.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2016-04-05
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Save file problem caused by the 04-01 patch solved.
[/list]

If you have played on a save since the last patch and exited to the main menu, you will not be able to load it. This will not happen again with the patch, but it doesn't fix the save files.

We are very sorry this happened. 
If you have a save file you want fixed, send it to us at beef@mightanddelight.com with "Bug: Save File" in the topic, together with which level each save slot should load.

notes.title: Patch 2016-04-01
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Performance fixes.
[*] Text color tweaks in the main menu (because of visibility problems with greyed out options).
[*] Inability to sense when a tutorial is up solved.
[*] Getting stuck in the main menu because of keybinding is no longer possible.
[*] Progress stat added to the achievement "What the past whispers"
[*] Soundtrack now have correctly spelled artist name and an album cover
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2016-03-28
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Performance fixes that could solve some of the reported crashes.
[*] Rare items not appearing on levels when replaying solved.
[*] Paws soundtrack now works in the Steam music player.
[*] Invert camera horizontal and vertical now works as intended.
[*] The achievement "Closure" now triggers as intended.
[*] The achievement "Treasure Hunter" now triggers as intended.
[/list]
